# Task
Deliver a proven dispute / chargeback lifecycle slice for this user task anchor: {task}

# Done When
- Dispute Contract Inspector has read-only frozen provider dispute fixtures, webhook signature/replay/order, retrieval request, representment evidence package deadline, reason codes, refund overlap, ledger/payout, notification/SLA, audit, monitoring, and governance targets.
- Chargeback Lifecycle Builder has implemented only after reading the contract handoff and left evidence refs for dispute state machine, evidence package, deadline scheduler, ledger/payout, notification/SLA, audit, monitoring, and governance.
- Dispute Evidence Inspector and Ledger Notification Inspector have run in the same parallel_group and separately verified lifecycle evidence and ledger/notification evidence.
- Dispute Chargeback GateKeeper closes only when core dispute lifecycle, webhook ordering, deadline/package, refund overlap, ledger/payout, notification/SLA, audit, monitoring, and local governance claims are Proven.

# Guardrails
- Do not accept UI-status-only, dashboard-outcome-only, provider-dispute-id-only, happy-path close, missing evidence package, missing deadline proof, missing refund-overlap negative, missing ledger/payout reconciliation, missing notification/SLA, missing audit trail, missing monitoring, or skipped local governance.
- Do not project customer notification into notification subscription-deliverability; here notification is a dispute lifecycle evidence surface.
- Do not project payout hold/release into payout settlement as the main task; here payout is a dispute ledger effect.
- Do not claim an observed stack, test runner, or existing implementation unless runtime workdir inspection proves it.

# Success Surface
- The user can audit these domain proof surfaces: {success_focus}.
- The user can see which claims are Proven, Weak, Unproven, Blocking, or Residual risk.

# Fake Done
- Shallow states that cannot pass: {fake_done_focus}.
- Missing evidence for these task risks must block: {evidence_focus}.

# Evidence Preferences
- Prefer provider fixture contract, signed/replay/out-of-order webhook cases, deadline scheduler proof, evidence package artifacts, refund/chargeback overlap negatives, ledger/payout reconciliation, notification delivery proof, merchant SLA cases, audit refs, monitoring alerts, command output, and durable artifacts.
- GateKeeper verdict must cite upstream evidence refs or artifacts, not only a final summary.

# Execution Strategy
Use Dispute Contract Inspector -> Chargeback Lifecycle Builder -> [Dispute Evidence Inspector + Ledger Notification Inspector] -> Dispute Chargeback GateKeeper. Both Inspectors share one parallel_group; GateKeeper reads all handoffs and evidence_query before failing closed or finishing.

# Judgment Tradeoffs
Deadline/package, refund overlap, ledger/payout reconciliation, notification/SLA, audit, and monitoring proof beat quickly showing dispute status.

# Residual Risk
Missing evidence package, deadline proof, refund-overlap negatives, ledger/payout reconciliation, notification/SLA, audit, monitoring, or local governance must fail closed. Only non-core display polish or named, visible, owned out-of-scope risks may remain as Residual risk.

# Role Notes
## Dispute Contract Inspector Notes
Freeze provider fixtures, webhook ordering, deadline, reason code, ledger/payout, notification/SLA, audit, monitoring, and governance targets read-only; do not implement.

## Chargeback Lifecycle Builder Notes
Implement only from the Dispute Contract Inspector handoff and leave changed surfaces, fixtures, command output, artifact refs, unproven claims, and blockers.

## Dispute Evidence Inspector Notes
Read contract plus builder handoffs in parallel and refute webhook ordering/replay/signature, retrieval request, evidence package, deadline scheduler, reason code, lifecycle states, refund overlap negatives, and stale alerts.

## Ledger Notification Inspector Notes
Read contract plus builder handoffs in parallel and refute provisional credit/debit, fee, invoice/balance adjustment, payout hold/release, notification delivery, merchant SLA, audit, privacy, and monitoring.

## Dispute Chargeback GateKeeper Notes
Judge from the four upstream handoffs and evidence_query; block when core dispute, webhook, deadline/package, ledger/payout, notification/SLA, audit, monitoring, or local-governance claims are not Proven.

# Dispute Chargeback Workflow Notes
- This workflow uses Dispute Contract Inspector -> Chargeback Lifecycle Builder -> [Dispute Evidence Inspector + Ledger Notification Inspector] -> Dispute Chargeback GateKeeper.
- GateKeeper must judge dispute-chargeback, webhook-ordering, provider-contract, evidence-deadline, reason-code, ledger-reconciliation, payout-settlement, payment-refund-billing, message-delivery, audit-log, privacy-redaction, monitoring, negative_evidence, and local-governance through evidence_query.

# Task
Deliver a proven implementation slice for this user task anchor: {task}

# Done When
- Metric Contract Inspector has read-only frozen MRR/ARR/churn/expansion/contraction/NRR definitions, metric definition version, edge cases, FX/cutoff/timezone, ledger/invoice/provider reconciliation, locked-month backfill, permission, export, audit, and local-governance proof targets.
- Revenue Dashboard Builder has implemented only after reading the contract handoff and left evidence refs for metric definitions, edge-case aggregation, FX/cutoff/timezone, ledger/invoice/provider reconciliation, dashboard/export parity, locked-month backfill, permission filtering, audit, monitoring, and governance.
- Metric Reconciliation Inspector and Permission Backfill Inspector have run in the same parallel_group and separately verified metric/ledger/export/drift and permission/backfill/audit/governance.
- Metric Reporting GateKeeper closes only when core metric, reconciliation, permission, backfill, audit, monitoring, and local governance claims are Proven.

# Guardrails
- Do not accept chart-only, CSV-only, provider-total-only, missing edge-case fixtures, missing ledger reconciliation, missing locked-month proof, missing permission negative, missing audit trail, missing monitoring, or skipped local governance.
- Do not project net revenue retention into data-lifecycle deletion / retention; here retention is revenue metric semantics.
- Do not claim an observed stack, test runner, or existing implementation unless runtime workdir inspection proves it.
- When AGENTS.md, design/README.md, design/, or tests/ exist, Builder must read applicable local rules, both Inspectors must verify related design/test/governance evidence, and GateKeeper must treat skipped local governance as Weak, Unproven, or Blocking.

# Success Surface
- The user can audit these domain proof surfaces: {success_focus}.
- The user can see which claims are Proven, Weak, Unproven, Blocking, or Residual risk.

# Fake Done
- Shallow states that cannot pass: {fake_done_focus}.
- Missing evidence for these task risks must block: {evidence_focus}.

# Evidence Preferences
- Prefer metric contract proof, edge-case fixtures, ledger/invoice/provider reconciliation queries, dashboard/export parity checks, locked-month no-rewrite proof, permission negatives, audit records, monitoring alerts, command output, and durable artifacts.
- Inspector evidence must name Proven, Weak, Unproven, Blocking, and Residual risk.
- GateKeeper verdict must cite upstream evidence refs or artifacts, not only a final summary.

# Execution Strategy
Use Metric Contract Inspector -> Revenue Dashboard Builder -> [Metric Reconciliation Inspector + Permission Backfill Inspector] -> Metric Reporting GateKeeper. Both Inspectors share one parallel_group; GateKeeper reads all handoffs and evidence_query before failing closed or finishing.

# Judgment Tradeoffs
Metric definitions, edge fixtures, revenue reconciliation, locked backfill, permissions, and audit proof beat quickly showing charts; speed cannot hide chart-only, CSV-only, or provider-total-only evidence.

# Residual Risk
Missing metric definition, edge fixtures, FX/cutoff/timezone, ledger reconciliation, locked-month backfill, permission negatives, audit, monitoring, or local governance must fail closed. Only non-core display polish or named, visible, owned out-of-scope risks may remain as Residual risk.

# Role Notes
## Metric Contract Inspector Notes
Freeze metric definitions, edge cases, reconciliation queries, locked backfill, permissions, exports, audit, monitoring, and local-governance proof targets read-only; do not implement.

## Revenue Dashboard Builder Notes
Implement only from the Metric Contract Inspector handoff and leave changed surfaces, fixtures, command output, artifact refs, unproven claims, and blockers.

## Metric Reconciliation Inspector Notes
Read contract plus builder handoffs in parallel and refute edge-case aggregation, FX/cutoff/timezone, provider/ledger/invoice reconciliation, dashboard/export parity, and drift alerts.

## Permission Backfill Inspector Notes
Read contract plus builder handoffs in parallel and refute segment permission negatives, historical backfill idempotency, locked-month no-rewrite, metric-version audit, backfill-run audit, permission-safe export, and governance.

## Metric Reporting GateKeeper Notes
Judge from the four upstream handoffs and evidence_query; block when core metric, reconciliation, permission, backfill, audit, monitoring, or local-governance claims are not Proven.
